annotation.title_clean: Design Approach of Medical Devices for Regulation Compatibility: A Robotic Rehabilitation Case Study
annotation.title_en: Design Approach of Medical Devices for Regulation Compatibility: A Robotic Rehabilitation Case Study
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Formicola, R.; Ragni, F.; Mor, M.; Bissolotti, L.; Amici, C.
annotation.venue: Proceedings of the 7th International Conference on ICT for Ageing Well and e-Health (ICT4AWE), SciTePress
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper presenting a design approach mapping the documentation required for CE marking of medical devices, applied to the LEPRE robotic leg-rehabilitation system. It focuses on clinical evaluation reports and equivalence demonstration under MEDDEV 2.7/1, to ease regulatory compatibility during design.
key_provisions_or_claims: Regulations and norms constrain medical device design requirements.
Proposes a custom mapping of data and documents required for CE marking.
Applied to the LEPRE robotic rehabilitation system.
Focuses on clinical evaluation report and equivalence per MEDDEV 2.7/1.
Suggests adaptations for other application fields.
